# SpritaScore
> Application Risk & Cost Calculator by Sprita IT

SpritaScore (https://spritascore.com) is a B2B web platform that turns software security, quality, and compliance risk into an executive estimate of financial impact. It is a brand of Sprita iT (https://sprita-it.com).

The score shown to visitors is 0–100. A higher number means higher exposure. Results are estimates from declared answers. They are not an audit, a certification, or a legal opinion.

## Languages
- English homepage: [SpritaScore](https://spritascore.com/)
- Spanish homepage: [SpritaScore en español](https://spritascore.com/es)
- Portuguese homepage: [SpritaScore em português](https://spritascore.com/pt)

## Primary capabilities
- Risk exposure score from 0 to 100 and an economic estimate
- Prioritized recommendations from the answers given
- A PDF report in the browser, without gating it behind a form
- Optional request for a scope review with Sprita iT

Spanish and Portuguese routes exist for the executive score, sector risk, EU AI Act, and the scope-review page.

- [English](https://spritascore.com/en/software-audit)
- [Spanish](https://spritascore.com/es/auditoria-de-software)

## Frameworks referenced
ISO/IEC 25010, OWASP Top 10, OWASP Mobile Top 10, EU Cyber Resilience Act, DORA, EU AI Act, and ASPM practice. SpritaScore does not certify compliance with any of them.
